terminal_objective: Turn the strongest portfolio assets into reusable, evidence-bounded person-level option packages while improving each asset toward its intended manifested capability.

Each role family has a fact-audited lead narrative, exact evidence references, limitations, and a reusable selection rule.
One reusable appointment packet distinguishes salary or stipend from restricted research support and binds every proposed study to executable evidence.

evidence_rules: Internal verification never becomes external validation.
A candidate branch is not described as canonical main.
A person-level packet selects evidence; projects do not compete as separate applicants.
Each case study states the exact demonstrated workflow and the strongest nonclaim.
No external action is implied by internal packet readiness.
